description: Did my Base transaction work and what did it cost? One call returns success or reverted, gas used, effective gas price, the fee in wei and in exact decimal ETH, confirmations behind the head, sender, recipient, value and log count. Pending and unknown hashes get a definite answer rather than an error. Pay 6000 atomic USDC on Base via exact x402. MCP does not pay; it provides a challenge handoff.
name: base_transaction_outcome
title: Base Transaction Outcome
